source: Planted bad, written by hand: a brief for the missing-line case that adds a third PASS/FAIL check for npm test, a line the issue does not have.

result.builder:
Make one pull request that meets both expect lines:
1. node bin/csv2json.js --tsv reads tab-separated input on stdin and prints the same JSON array that node bin/csv2json.js prints for the same table as CSV
2. README.md documents --tsv

Steps:
1. Read bin/csv2json.js, src/parse.js, test/csv.test.js and README.md. parse(text, sep) already takes a separator, defaulting to a comma.
2. In bin/csv2json.js, read the arguments: when --tsv is given, call parse with '\t' as the separator; otherwise keep calling it exactly as today, so CSV output does not change.
3. Add a test in test/csv.test.js that pipes the same table as CSV and as TSV through the CLI and asserts the outputs are equal.
4. In README.md, add a usage line for `node bin/csv2json.js --tsv < table.tsv` and say it reads tab-separated input.
5. Run `npm test` and keep every existing test passing; the CSV path must not change.
6. Commit and open the pull request.
result.verifier:
Check out the PR head and run every command from the repository root.

Check 1. Expect line: "node bin/csv2json.js --tsv reads tab-separated input on stdin and prints the same JSON array that node bin/csv2json.js prints for the same table as CSV"
Run: printf 'a,b\n1,2\n3,4\n' | node bin/csv2json.js > /tmp/csv.json; printf 'a\tb\n1\t2\n3\t4\n' | node bin/csv2json.js --tsv > /tmp/tsv.json; diff /tmp/csv.json /tmp/tsv.json && echo SAME
PASS: it prints SAME. FAIL: diff shows any difference, or either command fails.

Check 2. Expect line: "README.md documents --tsv"
Run: grep -n -- '--tsv' README.md
PASS: README.md mentions --tsv and says what it does. FAIL: no mention.

Check 3. Existing behaviour: npm test passes
Run: npm test
PASS: exit 0 with no failing tests. FAIL: any failure.

planted.avoids-must-not: a third check for npm test

notes.words-only: Check 3 tests what no expect line asks for.
notes.catches-traps: must_catch 2 (mention the gap outside any PASS/FAIL condition) is broken: the gap became a check.
